info.name: VideoGame Platform Backend - Personal Ratings
info.description: Executable UC-005 through UC-008 and UC-015 examples, including rating by platform (#359), for an authenticated local OIDC session. Sign in through Keycloak in a browser and sync the localhost cookie into Postman. The first request verifies that session and stores its CSRF token automatically; no OAuth token or credential belongs in this collection.

request.description: Requires the browser-created vgp_session cookie to be present in Postman's localhost cookie jar. Stores the session-bound CSRF token for the remaining requests.

exec: const authenticated = body.authenticated === true && typeof body.csrfToken === "string" && body.csrfToken.length > 0;
pm.test("Authenticated OIDC session is available", () => pm.expect(authenticated, "Open /auth/login/keycloak in a browser and sync the localhost cookie with Postman Interceptor").to.eql(true));

request.description: UC-015. Only the signed-in principal’s current ratings; fixed-size on-demand statistics, never an external score or play log.

exec: pm.test("Ten zero-filled buckets account for every game", () => { pm.expect(body.distribution).to.have.lengthOf(10); pm.expect(body.distribution.reduce((sum,n) => sum+n,0)).to.eql(body.total); });

pm.test("Mean of unrounded contributions, null only when empty", () => { if (body.total === 0) pm.expect(body.mean).to.eql(null); else { pm.expect(body.mean).to.be.within(1,10); const first = body.distribution.findIndex(n => n > 0) + 1; const last = 10 - [...body.distribution].reverse().findIndex(n => n > 0); pm.expect(body.mean).to.be.within(first - 0.5, last + 0.5); } });

pm.test("Bounded honest genre samples", () => { pm.expect(body.mostRatedGenres.length).to.be.at.most(6); pm.expect(body.bestRatedGenres.length).to.be.at.most(6); body.bestRatedGenres.forEach(g => pm.expect(g.count).to.be.at.least(3)); pm.expect(body.gamesWithoutGenres).to.be.within(0,body.total); });

pm.test("Twelve months plus older ratings account for the total", () => { pm.expect(body.activity).to.have.lengthOf(12); pm.expect(body.activity.reduce((sum,m) => sum+m.count,body.olderRatings)).to.eql(body.total); });

pm.test("Empty extremes are null", () => { if (body.total === 0) { pm.expect(body.highest).to.eql(null); pm.expect(body.lowest).to.eql(null); } else { pm.expect(body.highest.value).to.be.at.least(body.lowest.value); [body.highest, body.lowest].forEach(e => pm.expect(e.tiedGames).to.be.within(1, body.total)); } });

pm.test("Recorded platforms overlap, stay bounded and score only explicitly", () => { const p = body.platforms; pm.expect(p.items.length).to.be.at.most(6); pm.expect(p.gamesWithoutPlatforms).to.be.within(0, body.total); pm.expect(p.gamesOnSeveralPlatforms).to.be.within(0, body.total - p.gamesWithoutPlatforms); if (p.items.length < 6) pm.expect(p.otherPlatforms).to.eql(0); p.items.forEach((item, i) => { pm.expect(item.playedGames).to.be.within(1, body.total - p.gamesWithoutPlatforms); pm.expect(item.scoredGames).to.be.within(0, item.playedGames); pm.expect(item.mean === null).to.eql(item.scoredGames === 0); const next = p.items[i + 1]; if (next) pm.expect(item.playedGames > next.playedGames || (item.playedGames === next.playedGames && item.scoredGames >= next.scoredGames)).to.eql(true); }); });

pm.test("Five exhaustive platform association counts use their own denominator", () => { const p = body.platforms; const d = p.distribution; pm.expect(Object.keys(d).sort()).to.eql(["other", "ps5", "switch2", "windowsPc", "xboxSeries"]); const counts = Object.values(d); counts.forEach(n => { pm.expect(Number.isInteger(n)).to.eql(true); pm.expect(n).to.be.at.least(0); }); const total = counts.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0); pm.expect(total).to.be.within(body.total - p.gamesWithoutPlatforms, body.total * 50); const visible = p.items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.playedGames, 0); pm.expect(total).to.be.at.least(visible); if (p.otherPlatforms === 0) pm.expect(total).to.eql(visible); if (p.gamesWithoutPlatforms === body.total) pm.expect(total).to.eql(0); });

request.description: Identity is derived exclusively from the validated BFF principal; this read accepts no query parameters.

exec: pm.test("A direct score names a played platform without a score", () => { pm.expect(body.personalRating.mode).to.eql("direct"); pm.expect(body.personalRating.contribution).to.eql(8); pm.expect(body.personalRating.platforms.map(entry => entry.platform.platformId)).to.eql([pm.collectionVariables.get("ps5PlatformId")]); pm.expect(body.personalRating.platforms[0].value).to.eql(null); pm.expect(body.ratingStatistics.platforms).to.be.an("array"); });

pm.test("Read returns created validator", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("ETag")).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("createdRatingEtag")); pm.expect(body.entityTag).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("createdRatingEtag")); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("Cache-Control")).to.eql("no-store"); });

pm.test("The played platform is part of the rating", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.mode).to.eql("direct"); pm.expect(body.value).to.eql(8); pm.expect(body.platforms.map(entry => entry.platform.platformId)).to.eql([pm.collectionVariables.get("ps5PlatformId")]); });

item.name: List own ratings and capture the current collection ETag

request.description: Uses the authenticated session only. The subsequent update uses this collection item's strong ETag.

exec: pm.test("Default total ordering", () => { for (let i = 1; i < body.items.length; i++) { const previous = body.items[i - 1].personalRating; const current = body.items[i].personalRating; pm.expect(previous.updatedAt > current.updatedAt || (previous.updatedAt === current.updatedAt && previous.gameId < current.gameId)).to.eql(true); } });

pm.test("Compact localized genres only", () => { if (pm.response.code !== 200) return; const payload = pm.response.json(); payload.items.forEach(item => { const game = item.game || item; pm.expect(game.genres).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(game.genres.length).to.be.at.most(2); game.genres.forEach(term => { pm.expect(term.genreId).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(term.name).to.be.a("string"); }); ["summary", "developers", "publishers", "gameModes"].forEach(field => pm.expect(game).not.to.have.property(field)); }); });

pm.test("Community is compact and distinct from personal", () => { if (pm.response.code !== 200) return; pm.response.json().items.forEach(item => { const stats = item.ratingSummary; pm.expect(stats.status).to.be.oneOf(["available", "unavailable"]); pm.expect(stats).not.to.have.property("distribution"); if (stats.status === "available") { pm.expect(stats.count).to.be.at.least(0); pm.expect(stats.mean === null).to.eql(stats.count === 0); } else { pm.expect(stats).not.to.have.property("mean"); pm.expect(stats.reasonCode).to.eql("RATING_STATISTICS_READ_FAILED"); } }); });

pm.test("Optional IGDB player score stays separate, attributed and on /10", () => { if (pm.response.code !== 200) return; pm.response.json().items.forEach(item => { const s = item.externalScore; if (!s) return; pm.expect(s.source).to.eql("igdb"); pm.expect(s.kind).to.eql("player"); pm.expect(s.scale).to.eql(10); pm.expect(s.value).to.be.within(0, 10); pm.expect(Number.isInteger(s.count)).to.eql(true); pm.expect(s.count).to.be.at.least(1); pm.expect(s.attribution.label).to.eql("Jugadores IGDB"); pm.expect(s.attribution.sourceUrl).to.match(/^https:\/\/www\.igdb\.com\/games\/[^/?#]+$/); pm.expect(Number.isNaN(Date.parse(s.observedAt))).to.eql(false); }); });

pm.test("A scoped search is a valid private page", () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("Cache-Control")).to.eql("no-store"); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.items.length).to.be.at.most(20); pm.expect(body.page.number).to.eql(1); });

pm.test("Compact localized genres only", () => { if (pm.response.code !== 200) return; const payload = pm.response.json(); payload.items.forEach(item => { const game = item.game || item; pm.expect(game.genres).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(game.genres.length).to.be.at.most(2); game.genres.forEach(term => { pm.expect(term.genreId).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(term.name).to.be.a("string"); }); ["summary", "developers", "publishers", "gameModes"].forEach(field => pm.expect(game).not.to.have.property(field)); }); });

pm.test("Community is compact and distinct from personal", () => { if (pm.response.code !== 200) return; pm.response.json().items.forEach(item => { const stats = item.ratingSummary; pm.expect(stats.status).to.be.oneOf(["available", "unavailable"]); pm.expect(stats).not.to.have.property("distribution"); if (stats.status === "available") { pm.expect(stats.count).to.be.at.least(0); pm.expect(stats.mean === null).to.eql(stats.count === 0); } else { pm.expect(stats).not.to.have.property("mean"); pm.expect(stats.reasonCode).to.eql("RATING_STATISTICS_READ_FAILED"); } }); });
pm.test("Owner is never accepted from the client", () => { pm.response.to.have.status(422); pm.expect(pm.response.json().code).to.eql("REQUEST_PARAMETER_UNKNOWN"); });

pm.test("Compact localized genres only", () => { if (pm.response.code !== 200) return; const payload = pm.response.json(); payload.items.forEach(item => { const game = item.game || item; pm.expect(game.genres).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(game.genres.length).to.be.at.most(2); game.genres.forEach(term => { pm.expect(term.genreId).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(term.name).to.be.a("string"); }); ["summary", "developers", "publishers", "gameModes"].forEach(field => pm.expect(game).not.to.have.property(field)); }); });

pm.test("Community is compact and distinct from personal", () => { if (pm.response.code !== 200) return; pm.response.json().items.forEach(item => { const stats = item.ratingSummary; pm.expect(stats.status).to.be.oneOf(["available", "unavailable"]); pm.expect(stats).not.to.have.property("distribution"); if (stats.status === "available") { pm.expect(stats.count).to.be.at.least(0); pm.expect(stats.mean === null).to.eql(stats.count === 0); } else { pm.expect(stats).not.to.have.property("mean"); pm.expect(stats.reasonCode).to.eql("RATING_STATISTICS_READ_FAILED"); } }); });

pm.test("A command with only a value keeps the saved platforms", () => { pm.expect(body.personalRating.mode).to.eql("direct"); pm.expect(body.personalRating.platforms.map(entry => entry.platform.platformId)).to.eql([pm.collectionVariables.get("ps5PlatformId")]); });

pm.test("Platform scores replace the general value with their mean", () => { pm.expect(body.personalRating.mode).to.eql("platforms"); pm.expect(body.personalRating.value).to.eql(null); pm.expect(body.personalRating.contribution).to.eql(8.5); pm.expect(body.personalRating.entityTag).to.eql(etag); });

pm.test("Each scored platform has its own community reading", () => { const ids = body.ratingStatistics.platforms.map(entry => entry.platform.platformId); pm.expect(ids).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get("ps5PlatformId")); pm.expect(ids).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get("pcPlatformId")); body.ratingStatistics.platforms.forEach(entry => pm.expect(entry.count).to.be.at.least(1)); });

pm.test("The user still casts one community vote", () => { const buckets = Object.values(body.ratingStatistics.distribution).reduce((sum, count) => sum + count, 0); pm.expect(buckets).to.eql(body.ratingStatistics.count); });

item.name: Reject a general value over platform scores

exec: pm.test("Stable score-source code and no change", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.code).to.eql("RATING_SCORE_SOURCE_INVALID"); pm.expect(body.violations[0].pointer).to.eql("/value"); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("Cache-Control")).to.eql("no-store"); });

item.name: Reject a platform the game is not released on

exec: pm.test("Stable platform code names the position", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.code).to.eql("PLATFORM_NOT_SUPPORTED"); pm.expect(body.violations[0].pointer).to.eql("/platforms/0/platformId"); });

pm.test("Personal state is absent and aggregate remains coherent", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.personalRating).to.eql(null); pm.expect(body.ratingStatistics.status).to.eql("available"); pm.expect(body.ratingStatistics.platforms).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("Cache-Control")).to.eql("no-store"); });
